FIVE_MINUTE_MEAN_REVERSION.evidence: 67.26% HOLDOUT reversal over 55,340 sampled move episodes; every temporal worker >66%; survives move-size, price-region, relative-spread and state slices.

DEPTH_NORMALISED_OFI.evidence: Frozen OFI challenger improves full-panel HOLDOUT log-loss by 0.004165 over 1,195,563 observations; 5/5 workers positive. Simple sign is often contrarian, so do not import textbook trend-following interpretation.

PRICE_DISCOVERY.evidence: Short high-vol state; 47.38% of HOLDOUT exits go to POST_SHOCK, p90 dwell <=4 minutes in all workers. Still 68.08% sampled reversal.

LIQUIDITY_STRESS.evidence: HOLDOUT exit hazard 4.93%/min with long dwell; 23.15% of exits to REPLENISHMENT.

RESILIENCE_REPLENISHMENT.evidence: After large withdrawal, next-minute recovered episodes have 33.83% lower subsequent abs-5m movement on HOLDOUT, 5/5 workers same direction. Association only.

FLOW_PERSISTENCE.evidence: TRAIN/DEV fill-direction same-side run persistence is stable; broad signed-volume lag-1 correlation is negative. Fill HOLDOUT intentionally unspent.

QUOTE_LIFETIME_UPDATE_HAZARD.evidence: DEV quote/BBO interarrival median roughly 29-35ms; state often changes during realistic 25-100ms exposure. Not queue/fill probability.

STATIC_DEPTH_IMBALANCE.evidence: Weak/unstable incremental directional value relative to frozen baseline.

MICROPRICE.evidence: Killed on TRAIN before DEV; negligible/unstable incremental log-loss.

RAW_EVENT_OFI.evidence: Nearby event OFI object did not improve the frozen baseline reliably.

VISIBLE_MULTI_LEVEL_FLOW.evidence: Normalised visible level flow did not add stable one-minute directional information.

LOB_SHAPE.evidence: Depth concentration, entropy, shape distance and wall ratio were not temporally stable incremental predictors.

COMMON_LIQUIDITY.evidence: Useful context for market-wide state, but generic common-liquidity direction did not add stable TRAIN prediction.

GENERIC_BOOK_AGE_DIRECTION.evidence: Age did not add stable next-move direction here; separate renewal/update-hazard evidence from other experiments was deliberately not duplicated.

PRESSURE_PROXY.evidence: Positive average TRAIN increment but inconsistent temporal signs.

COARSE_CLUSTERING.evidence: Three coarse modes reproducible, but higher-state solutions unstable and Gaussian likelihood kept rewarding extra components.

HMM_MARKOV_SWITCHING.evidence: Did not earn complexity beyond transparent states.

HAWKES.evidence: Not justified before a materially better simple regime/intensity baseline.

KYLE_AMIHUD_IMPACT.evidence: Available sampled trade/order-book surface does not support a clean impact estimate with the required semantics.

VPIN.evidence: Not promoted after simpler flow/state diagnostics.

SPREAD_DECOMPOSITION.evidence: Fill/book decomposition belongs to 005H and was not duplicated.

TICK_BOUNDARY_PRICE_REGION.evidence: Mean reversion survives fixed price-region and relative-spread slices; exact causal tick-boundary attribution is not established.
